gen-gf-offside-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro moves along with strokes like a bent steel rod. Offside, the heading, is widely tracked and commanding, with curves that refuse to close, while the body stays quiet and clean.
gen-gf-offside-fs-fira-sans: Wide-tracked and stubborn, with curves left open. Offside carries the drama, while Fira Sans stays uniform in stroke with a larger-than-usual x-height, and the gap between them is the draw.
gen-gf-offside-gf-julius-sans-one: Offside lays down widely tracked, commanding letters whose curves refuse to close, with no accents of weight anywhere. Julius Sans One adds open-ended curves and wide gaps, so both lines breathe.
gen-gf-offside-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips apart and its mean line high, a modern body beneath the widely tracked Offside. Paragraphs in it should move along smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads clean and sturdy, with a larger-than-usual x-height. Oxanium is best at commanding attention with its monoline strokes, while Fira Sans is best at carrying text with wide, open curves.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-rowan: Relaxed, Patrick Hand SC scribbles its crowded letters with no stroke modulation. Rowan then reads warmly, its curves generously open, and is happiest taken a little at a time.
gen-gf-risque-fs-rowan: Expressive Risque takes the stage with low stroke contrast. Rowan, with generous curve openings and middling contrast, is a literary, friendly partner, made for quick visits rather than long ones.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-amulya: A single-weight outline feel, with Sniglet stopping its terminals short. Amulya, meanwhile, is best at quiet, low-contrast text with generous curve gaps, leaving the showing off to the heading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-special-gothic: Special Gothic reads rounded, open and inviting, a modern body set under Sniglet, whose constant-thickness neon tubing letters stand out. The standout is a glowing heading above a gentle body.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-newa: Stencil bridges run wide between the letters of Snowburst One, a bold heading with an opening like a sprung paper clip. Noto Sans Newa echoes that with tall, open lowercase counters.
